decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'. Every effort shall be made to retain as much fine leaf bearing structure as possible. The tree must not be stripped bare. The previous pruning points shall not be exceeded.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
description: Works to a tree covered by LBE ORDER NO 102 1980: T1 Ash (Fraxinus excelsior) - Crown reduce by 2m, remove of all major deadwood.
